verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a project instructions or conventions file that Aider automatically follows for coding standards. The nearest items are adjacent: .aider.conf.yml sets tool options rather than coding conventions, /add puts files into the chat for editing, and --watch-files picks up inline AI comments. None of these is the requested capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a project instructions file to set coding standards and conventions the agent follows
